name: Conical Bowl with Decoration of a Blossoming Plum Branch under Crescent Moon and Clouds
summary: Conical bowl covered all over, except for the base and small footring, witha  chocolate0brown glaze. The inside walls of the bowl feature a spontaneously stylized depiction of a blossoming plum branch under a new moon by which pass small clouds, the designs spontaneously brushed in ash and buff slip atop the glaze before firing.
